body:
Review of PROGRAM-PLAN.md §2 + §4-Phase-0 and GATES.md. Seven defects, ordered by severity. Nothing here is a preference; each has a citation.

E1 CONTRADICTION — D-005 vs task 0.1.
D-005 (accepted) says: one guard at the dereference helper, "no new per-site patches without a DECIDE".
Task 0.1 says: "Fix 0x681817: patch the join". Those cannot both be current. Either 0.1 is superseded by D-005, or D-005 needs amending before 0.1 is executed. As written, NET will do the thing D-005 forbids.

E2 — 0.1 under-specifies the fix; a one-instruction patch still faults.
At 0x681801 `test edi,edi` / 0x681803 `jz short loc_681817`, the NULL branch lands ON the dereference:
  0x681817 movzx ecx, word ptr [edi+2B6h]
and the block continues to dereference the same null pointer:
  0x68181E mov eax, [edi+248h]
  0x681828 imul eax, 290h
  0x68182E add eax, [edi+2B0h]
Redirecting only 0x681817 is insufficient. The skip must land past the whole block (>= 0x681838), and the EDI-null case must still leave the caller's state consistent. 0.1 should name the landing address, not "patch the join".

E3 — gate naming contradicts itself.
PROGRAM-PLAN §4 Phase 0: "run_audit.ps1 --rebuild reports AG0, AG2, AG4 and AG5 green (the audit rig's gates — AG prefix)".
GATES.md M0: "audit gates | M0, M2, M4, M5 all PASS".
One prefix is wrong. A reader cannot tell whether M0 checks AG0-AG5 or M0/M2/M4/M5.

E4 — EntityRef cannot represent a session-local id, so it cannot be the wire identity as written.
§2 defines `uint64_t objectId` as the sole identity. The engine has two populations:
  - authored ids, inserted verbatim from parsed data via sub_406AE0 -> sub_A0BE50 -> sub_A0BBF0 (0xA0BD40/0xA0BD43);
  - minted ids, sub_A1C9A0 = `mov eax,1; lock xadd [ecx]; inc eax; xor edx,edx` on the counter at 0x4DD982C, initialised once per process to 0xF0000000 at 0x1E323C1 (upper bound 0xF8000000 at 0x4DD9830). Minted ids are allocation-order, therefore differ per machine.
Additionally the object-reference serialiser nulls 0xFFFFFFFF and every id in [0xF0000000, 0xF7FFFFFF] at a51ca7 / a51cb8.
So a bare objectId in that band is not portable and not persistent. EntityRef needs an id-kind (authored vs session-local), or the band must be excluded and host-assigned. Evidence from a live run: a street guard carried 0xF0005CE3.

E5 — classTag at 16 bits will collide.
Engine class ids are full 32-bit; e.g. CRC32("CSrvNPCHealth") = 0x57EEEEC7 (verified at 0x1371140's class compare). With ~1376 classes in the registry, truncation to 16 bits gives an expected ~14 collisions (1376^2 / (2*65536)). Recommend the full 32 bits, or a closed enum.

E6 — GATES.md names four scene scripts that do not exist.
ops/tools/scene_roam.py (M1), scene_fight.py (M2), scene_stealth.py (M3), scene_ship.py (M4). ops/tools contains exactly one file: gate.py. Every gate's entry criteria reference a script nobody can run.

E7 — STATE.json is stale, which matters because gate.py hashes against it.
STATE.json: build.commit = "958b435", dirty = ["docs/HANDOFF-STATE.md"].
Actual: HEAD 69adc399c7d7dd400458c37294f6d67a1175830c, working tree clean (the HANDOFF-STATE correction was committed as 69adc39). ASI hash f474422f... still matches, so only the commit/dirty fields are wrong.

E8 (minor) — GATES.md M0 requires "0x681817 present in HOOK-TABLE.md, and the site is guarded". HOOK-TABLE.md currently has zero references to 0x681817 and deref_guard.cpp does not contain the address. M0 is correctly red, but the row reads as though the entry exists. Phrase it as a requirement.

Checked and found CORRECT, so nobody re-does them:
  - 0x9F0B50 -> sub_A200D0 returns the id in EDX:EAX (epilogue a20123 mov edx,edi / a20126 mov eax,esi). The [D] tag in §2 is right.
  - The authority table matches the binary's model: damage is causer-applied through the per-class handler's compute/commit virtual pair, and sub_133F5A0 is the transition only.
  - D-009's "SetLife at 0x19FB4C0, storage +0x5C is callable but coarse" is accurate: that setter stores and does nothing else.
  - Alive predicate note for GATES/M2: sub_133F550 is an OR of three conditions (null entity; sub_7025F0(e)+0xB8 & 0x0C == 4; sub_10EF8C0(e)+4 & 0x1000). Any gate prose that says AND is wrong.

No source edits made. src/ is untouched since 958b435; the only commit after it is docs/HANDOFF-STATE.md (69adc39). Standing by for ORCH.
